content: [teammember anim="fadeInLeft" type="1" name="Femme Rouge" position="Chic Holiday" photo="/wp-content/uploads/2015/12/Raw-Tear-1.jpg"]Put away your pots and pans and turn off your oven. We’re talking raw foods—as in uncooked. The motto could be, “You cook it, you kill it,” and the evidence will make you a believer. We consulted Dr. Brian Clement, director of the famed Hippocrates Wellness (HHI) in West Palm Beach to explore the many benefits of going raw, and find out just what’s involved in switching to a “living foods” lifestyle.
